sentences: Stochastic decision-theoretic online learning repeatedly selects among K actions with different expected losses.
The 2024 source asks for the optimal gap-dependent pseudo-regret under epsilon-differential privacy.
Its nonprivate benchmark scales as \(\log (K)\) divided by the smallest positive gap between the best and competing actions.
That gap measures how much statistical evidence is available for distinguishing good decisions from worse ones.

Determining the private counterpart would isolate the additional cost of protecting individual observations, including whether it introduces a dependence on the number of rounds that the nonprivate benchmark avoids.
